p.note: PHARMACOPOLAE,& alij quidam, Raías exicca= re, & sceletos earum in uarías admirabilésque uulgo figuras effingere solēt, cum alías, tum quæ Serpentem aut Dracó= nem alatum præ se ferant. Corpus enim inflectunt: caput & os distorquent: aliqua incidunt, aut circuncidunt, laterum anteriorem partem aliquousq; rescindunt: reliquum erigunt, ut alas simulet: & alia pro arbitrio comminiscuntur. Talem sceleton olim mihi depictum qualemcunque huc apposui.
GERMAN. Sie cörpel von todtnen Rocchen werdend vff dise vñ andere man cherley wyß seltzam zügerüst vnnd gedeert.

page.notes: The engraving shows a dried ray fashioned into a winged serpent or dragon figure, with a head and tail; the lower figure is a small engraved fish captioned "Squatina à Rondeletio exhibita". The marginal column text is set in a narrow column at left; the German passage is in black letter and is transcribed with the black letter forms as printed (s rendered as s). Some letters in the German are uncertain and may be misread.
